program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (gray-row (let loop
                                 ((r 0))
                                 (if (for/and ((c (range 0 ww))) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                     r
                                     (loop (+ r 1)))))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (let ((v (at g r c)))
                     (when
                       (or (= v 1) (= v 2))
                       (let* ((above (< r gray-row))
                              (dir (cond
                                     ((and (= v 1) above) -1)
                                     ((and (= v 1) (not above)) 1)
                                     ((and (= v 2) above) 1)
                                     (else -1))))
                         (let loop
                              ((rr (+ r dir)))
                              (when
                                (and (>= rr 0) (< rr hh) (zero? (at g rr c)))
                                (hash-set! result (list rr c) v)
                                (loop (+ rr dir))))))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (gray-row (let loop
                                 ((r 0))

                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (let ((v (at g r c)))
                     (when
                       (or (= v 1) (= v 2))
                       (let* ((above (< r gray-row))
                              (dir (cond
                                     ((and (= v 1) above) -1)
                                     ((and (= v 1) (not above)) 1)
                                     ((and (= v 2) above) 1)
                                     (else -1))))
                         (let loop
                              ((rr (+ r dir)))
                              (when
                                (and (>= rr 0) (< rr hh) (zero? (at g rr c)))
                                (hash-set! result (list rr c) v)
                                (loop (+ rr dir))))))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))) g))
             (parts (sort (map (lambda (xs) (sort xs cell<)) (find-0-regions base 0))
                          (lambda (a b) (cell< (car a) (car b))))))
        (if (null? parts) base
            (let* ((chosen (pick-max parts length)) (cells chosen)
                   (empty-cells (filter (lambda (p) (= (at base (first p) (second p)) 0)) cells)))
              (recolor-cells base empty-cells 8))))))
